Name: (CP) Missy's Walls and Floors
Author: EmissaryOfWind
Description:
This mod adds 61 wallpapers and 27 floors, created by MissyDiabolical and converted to Content Patcher as a non-replacer for Stardew Valley versions 1.5.5 and later by EmissaryofWind. These wallpapers and floors can be found in the Catalogue sold at Pierre's. 

Installation:
- Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]- Unzip this mod and drop the contents in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder﻿﻿
